tasks.title: Add Task and BuildStatus types, API methods, and React Query hooks
tasks.description: Add `Task` and `BuildStatus` interfaces to `web/src/lib/types.ts`. Add `getTasks(number)` and `getBuildStatus(number)` methods to `web/src/lib/api.ts` using the existing `request<T>()` helper. Add `useTasks(number)` and `useBuildStatus(number)` React Query hooks to `web/src/hooks/useQueries.ts` with query keys `['issues', number, 'tasks']` and `['issues', number, 'build-status']`, enabled only when `number > 0`.
acceptanceCriteria: Task interface has id, title, description?, acceptanceCriteria?, dependsOn?, passes, attempts, error?
BuildStatus interface has stage, status, progress { completed, failed, total, currentTask }, tasks
api.getTasks(5) sends GET /api/issues/5/tasks
api.getBuildStatus(5) sends GET /api/issues/5/build-status
useTasks(5) registers query with key ['issues', 5, 'tasks']
useBuildStatus(5) registers query with key ['issues', 5, 'build-status']
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow existing patterns in api.ts (request<T> helper) and useQueries.ts (useQuery with enabled guard).

tasks.title: Create useTaskProgress hook for SSE real-time cache updates
tasks.spec: specs/task-progress-sse/spec.md#useTaskProgress hook listens to SSE events for real-time updates
tasks.description: Create `web/src/hooks/useTaskProgress.ts`. Subscribe to `ralph_task_update` and `ralph_loop_progress` via `onAgentEvent` from `agent-events.ts`. Filter events by `event.issueId === String(issueNumber)`. On ralph_task_update, update the matching task in both `['issues', number, 'tasks']` and `['issues', number, 'build-status']` caches via `queryClient.setQueryData`. On ralph_loop_progress, update the progress object in `['issues', number, 'build-status']`. Return early (skip) if cache is undefined. Clean up listeners on unmount.
acceptanceCriteria: ralph_task_update with status 'completed' sets task passes=true in cache
ralph_task_update with status 'failed' sets task error in cache
ralph_task_update with status 'started' clears task error and sets currentTask in build-status cache
ralph_loop_progress updates completed/failed/total in build-status cache
Events with non-matching issueId are ignored
Listeners are cleaned up on component unmount
Undefined cache is handled gracefully without errors
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow the onAgentEvent + useEffect cleanup pattern from useSessionTimeline.ts. Import AgentDetailEventMap from types for event payload types.

tasks.title: Create TaskList component with status indicators, blocked hints, and progress summary
tasks.description: Create `web/src/components/TaskList.tsx` as a pure presentational component. Accept props: `tasks` (Task[]), `currentTask` (string|null), `progress` ({ completed, failed, total }). Return null if tasks is empty. Show a header with 'Tasks' and progress summary (e.g. '5/8 completed'). Render each task with a status icon: green check for passes=true, red X with inline error text for passes=false&&error, blue pulsing dot for the current running task, gray circle for pending. For tasks with dependsOn referencing uncompleted tasks, show 'blocked by T-xxx' hint.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns null when tasks array is empty
Shows 'Tasks' header with 'X/Y completed' progress summary
Completed tasks (passes=true) show green check icon
Failed tasks (passes=false && error) show red X icon with inline error text below title
Running task (matches currentTask) shows blue pulsing dot
Pending tasks (passes=false, no error, not current) show gray circle
Tasks with unmet dependsOn show 'blocked by T-xxx' hint
Tasks with all dependsOn met or no dependsOn show no hint
Uses existing Tailwind card styling pattern (rounded-lg border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Pure presentational component, no hooks or data fetching. Props interface should accept Task[] with dependsOn field.

tasks.title: Wire TaskList and useTaskProgress into IssueDetailPage
tasks.description: Modify `web/src/components/IssueDetailPage.tsx` to: (1) Import TaskList, useBuildStatus, useTasks, useTaskProgress. (2) Call useBuildStatus(issueNumber) and useTasks(issueNumber). (3) Call useTaskProgress(issueNumber) for SSE-driven cache updates. (4) Merge build-status tasks with tasks endpoint data by task ID to supplement dependsOn. (5) Render TaskList between the Description card and Comments card, only when issue stage is plan, build, review, or done.
acceptanceCriteria: TaskList appears between Description and Comments sections
TaskList is visible when issue stage is plan, build, review, or done
TaskList is hidden when issue stage is draft or explore
useTaskProgress(issueNumber) is called for SSE real-time updates
Tasks from build-status are merged with tasks endpoint data (dependsOn supplemented)
Progress summary reflects correct completed/total counts
No existing functionality is broken (stage bar, comments, actions all still work)
Web UI builds without errors (npm run build in packages/cli/web)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Insert TaskList after the Description card (around line 259) and before the Comments card. Merge tasks by ID: build-status provides id/title/passes/attempts/error, tasks endpoint adds dependsOn.
